sites.name: Star Tech
sites.note: Large official-warranty retailer; every phone page has a full spec table, regular vs discounted price, stock status and per-variant prices (variant price loaded by the page's own variation request). Best specsSource. Official stock only; sometimes undercuts official MRP.

sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Authorised/official retailer chain; one URL per RAM/storage variant with JSON-LD price and stock, regular price exposed in page data. Prices track official MRP. Official stock only.

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Sells both official ('-official' URLs) and unofficial/international stock as separate pages; per-variant price, discount and stock quantity in page data. Good for official vs grey comparison.

sites.name: Kry International
sites.note: Big official + unofficial catalogue with separate '-official' pages; unofficial variants carry a region code (IND, GLOBAL, Vietnam, Malaysia). Per-variant price and stock in page data. One page returned a transient 502 and succeeded on retry.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Official ('-official' URLs) and unofficial stock; full per-variant price, compare price and status (in-stock / pre-order / online-order) in page data. Unofficial pages do not state region, so condition there is inferred from the separate official listing and price gap.

sites.name: Dazzle
sites.note: Mostly unofficial/grey imports (variant names state Global/China) plus some official listings; good cheap-end reference. MRP shown is often inflated, so oldPrice there is the site's MRP, not the official price.

sites.name: Diamu
sites.note: WooCommerce shop with unofficial stock; per-variant prices in page data. Thin coverage and many current models out of stock (Y31d, Realme 15 Pro, A17 5G were out of stock with no price).

sites.name: Mobile Dokan
sites.note: Price/spec information site, not a shop. Used only as a reference for official BD MRP and release dates; no offers recorded from it.
